parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description:
The name of the task. Valid values:

*   **CLIENT\_PROBLEM_CHECK**: client diagnosis task
*   **CLIENT\_DEV_OPS**: O\&M task of Cloud Assistant
*   **ASSETS_COLLECTION**: asset collection task

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The type of the task. Valid values:

*   **CLIENT\_PROBLEM_CHECK**: client diagnosis task
*   **CLIENT\_DEV_OPS**: O\&M task of Cloud Assistant
*   **ASSETS\_COLLECTION**: asset collection task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-last-once-task-info --task-type ASSETS_COLLECTION --task-name ASSETS_COLLECTION --source console_batch --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas GetLastOnceTaskInfo --region cn-hangzhou --TaskName ASSETS_COLLECTION --TaskType ASSETS_COLLECTION --Source console_batch
